notes: Who qualifies for expedited service, 7 CFR 273.2(i)(1), in the regulation’s words (RL-5; read November 13, 2026 on eCFR, title 7 up to date as of November 10, 2026, and in the 2025 annual edition on govinfo, the same word for word; the section was last amended July 14, 2020, so the November 9 reading this file froze holds): “(1) Entitlement to expedited service. The following households are entitled to expedited service: (i) Households with less than $150 in monthly gross income, as computed in § 273.10 provided their liquid resources (i.e., cash on hand, checking or savings accounts, savings certificates, and lump sum payments as specified in § 273.9(c)(8)) do not exceed $100; (ii) Migrant or seasonal farmworker households who are destitute as defined in § 273.10(e)(3) provided their liquid resources (i.e., cash on hand, checking or savings accounts, savings certificates, and lump sum payments as specified in § 273.9(c)(8)) do not exceed $100; (iii) Households whose combined monthly gross income and liquid resources are less than the household's monthly rent or mortgage, and utilities (including entitlement to a SUA, as appropriate, in accordance with § 273.9(d)).”
derivation: The rows of govinfo-snap-application-steps in reading order: the main path by its order, then the branch. next_step names the main step that follows each step (the first also names the branch, with the condition the branch summary opens with); the last step of the path says it ends, and the branch’s next step is the postponed proof, due by the second or third month of benefits, with its interview inside the 7 days (7 CFR 273.2(i)(3)(iii) and (i)(4)(iii)(A), as the research lead read them November 13, 2026). path_words puts the path column in words. No other value changes.
